messages:
Evelyn: Skyline Partners found a pricing rule bug that applied a legacy promo to their channel accounts for Feb

nd Mar. They've asked Redwood for a retrocredit to reconcile.
Tom: Can you share the liability number and a sample row?
Evelyn: Skyline sent CSV. Quick roll-up = $11,250 across 13 accounts after proration. Sample they pasted: `invoice_id,account,period,charged,should_have,delta\ninv-8803,SkyStore-9,2025-03,$1,500,$1,150,$350`
Jade: Given amount > $10k we should loop CFO, but operationally we can do a consolidated partner adjustment if Skyline will accept and allocate downstream.
Rory: Ops question  wire vs credit memo? For third-party partners we usually prefer a credit memo, but Skyline requested a virtual card payout to speed merchant reimbursements. That's unusual.
Evelyn: They specifically asked for a P-Card/virtual-card reimbursement and provided a vendor billing contact.
Tom: Finance lead here  approve consolidated partner retrocredit of $11,250 to Skyline, GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025`, memo: "Skyline legacy promo retrocredit Feb

pr 2025". Will need CFO acknowledgement and a signed allocation ack before payout.
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-5133 for manual retrocredit workflow. Owner: Evelyn. Status: awaiting CFO ack + attachments. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-5133
CFO-Mike: Saw the thread  quick note: okay to proceed with finance lead approval but I want the posting to be at month-end with a one-line disclosure in the close pack. Also, please avoid virtual card if tax/KYC reasons complicate things; prefer wire or credit memo.
Rory: Payments ops: virtual card vendors have higher fees and reconciliation overhead. We prefer ACH/wire or credit memo. If Skyline insists on virtual card, payments needs a vendor onboarding checklist (KYC + card provider).
Evelyn: I'll ask Skyline if they're OK with a credit memo. Also attaching the CSV snippet to FIN-5133.
Tom: Tax check: tag `tax-team` and confirm any sales/VAT ramifications if Skyline distributes credits to merchants. We need a short tax memo before posting.
finance-bot: FIN-5133 updated: attachments required = CSV, Skyline signed allocation ack PDF, KYC docs if payout is virtual card, CFO ack link.
Evelyn: Skyline replied: they prefer credit memo instead of virtual card; they've signed the allocation ack and attached it (PDF). They also provided partner ref `SKY-RETRO-0325`.
Rory: Payments ops: great, we'll issue a consolidated credit memo. Please confirm the exact memo text and GL code to use.
Tom: Use GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025`. Memo (exact): "Skyline legacy promo retrocredit Feb-Mar 2025. Partner ref: SKY-RETRO-0325."
finance-bot: FIN-5133 status -> ready-for-posting. Ready attachments present: CSV + Skyline ack. Awaiting tax memo and posting window.
Evelyn: Tax-team: can you confirm VAT/sales tax note?
finance-bot: tax-team added to thread.
tax-team: Quick reply: partner credits that are simply adjustments to prior invoicing typically are tax-neutral if documented as reductions to gross revenue; confirm that Skyline will document pass-through allocations. We'll provide a short note for the close pack once we review the CSV.
CFO-Mike: Confirmed earlier approval. Please post on 2025-04-30 EOD so it sits in April accruals. Add one-line to month-end: "Partner retrocredit to Skyline for legacy promo misapplication, $11,250."
Rory: Drafting CM now. Will include partner ref and attach CSV + ack. ETA posting 2025-04-30 EOD.
payments-bot: Created payment record PMT-3102 for credit memo posting and ledger entry.
Evelyn: After posting, please update the Q1/Q2 reconciliation workbook and tag the correction lines with `partner-retro` label.
Rory: Credit memo posted: CM-2025-3170, posted 2025-04-30, amount $11,250. Ledger GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025`. Attached CM and CSV to FIN-5133. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: FIN-5133 closed by Rory. Posting reference CM-2025-3170.
Tom: Thanks team. Product ask: add a rule in onboarding to block legacy promo flags from being applied to partner-managed accounts. Filed P-1399 and assigned to Billing team.
Evelyn: Noted. Closing loop with Skyline and adding the month-end note now.
Rory: Month-end comment added: "Partner retrocredit to Skyline Partners for legacy promo misapplication, $11,250, posted CM-2025-3170."
Tom: All set. :thumbsup:
